statement: Support a full-scale model space and paper space layouts on named tabs for sheet composition, switchable via the tabs and the TILEMODE variable.

source.ref: About Model Space and Paper Space

acceptance.sketch: Create layout with 420x297 sheet; objects in paper space do not appear in model tab; TILEMODE=1 returns to model.

notes: Verified against help page "About Model Space and Paper Space". Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-02F55DD8-1EB1-493C-929D-A7CFDE55C348 | prior app hint: cand2 app registers Layout, Layouts, Detail; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row.

statement: Provide LAYOUT options to copy, delete, create, rename, set current, list, save as template, and create a layout from a template, DWG or DXF file.

notes: Verified against help page "LAYOUT (Command)". Corrected: There is no 'move' option on the command (tabs are reordered by dragging); 'import' is the Template option. | prior app hint: cand2 app registers Layout, CopyLayout, ImportLayout; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row.
